scope: Primary-source attribution and explicit separation of reconstruction, project proofs, finite evaluation and open targets. A source's conjecture is not promoted to a theorem by the local finite calculations.

sources.title: The Quantum DELL System
sources.use: Published current, left normalization, theta convention and originally conjectural quantum commutativity.
sources.convention_audit: The implementation calls the standard multiplicative theta nome P; it equals the square of this paper's p. Quantum shifts follow the stated action on functions, fixing S_i X_i=Q X_i S_i. The overall Fourier-mode sign is removed consistently.

sources.title: Characteristic determinant and Manakov triple for the double elliptic integrable system
sources.use: Theta-ratio current convention and an existing structural comparison. Dividing all raw modes by the same left coordinate factor leaves the left-normalized Hamiltonians unchanged.

sources.title: On the status of DELL systems
sources.use: Distinguishes the KS model and the desired self-dual DELL programme; prevents conflating a reconstructed formal current with a universal self-dual construction.

sources.authors: H. W. Braden; A. Marshakov; A. Mironov; A. Morozov
sources.title: On Double-Elliptic Integrable Systems. 1. A Duality Argument for the case of SU(2)
sources.use: Historical two-particle benchmark. The present work does not claim to introduce the first double-elliptic Hamiltonian.

sources.title: Complete integrability of relativistic Calogero-Moser systems and elliptic function identities
sources.use: Imported classical and quantum type-A Ruijsenaars involutivity; the scoped profile theorem does not claim this historical result.

sources.title: The Diamond: DELL vertex
sources.use: Author-maintained status check distinguishing general KS quantum commutativity and open geometric identifications from established constructions.

project_results: Global symbolic first- and second-momentum-order classical identities and first mixed-coordinate/momentum-nome identity.
Complete six-function first-shell and21product second-order normalizer boundary, including quotient by actual function dependencies.
Analytic common-profile classification for unchanged three-particle RS weights for all couplings, with a conditional coordinate-elliptic neighborhood extension.
Formal generic functional independence and moment-map descent, separated from commutativity.
Exact finite-order classical and normal-ordered quantum replays with explicit nonzero controls.
not_claimed: A proof of all-order many-body quantum DELL commutativity
A quantum dynamical E8 double-elliptic R-matrix
An all-model uniqueness or no-existence theorem
Verified worldwide priority for the scoped project theorems
